title: PR body fold-proof cites wrong previous boot tick-1 hash
evidence:
_bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md:51: "FNV-hashes to the previous golden tick-1 **exactly** (`ab1fb0d04a90026c`); the un-spliced dump hashes to the blessed tick-1 (`d1d2e53b7b1037ce`)."
git show aec3c88:goldens/boot.t1: "catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860" / "1 6c24e9cec592aece"
./harness.bin fold-check 66c4324a06058860 6c24e9cec592aece -> "spliced prev      6c24e9cec592aece" / "fold-check: PASS"
detail: The PR body documents the fold proof's prev tick-1 as ab1fb0d04a90026c, but the actual pre-5.11 boot.t1 tick-1 is 6c24e9cec592aece, which the new fold-check subcommand reproduces. The cited number is stale and misleads re-verification.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body's value to 6c24e9cec592aece (git show aec3c88:goldens/boot.t1), matching what `harness fold-check 66c4324a06058860 6c24e9cec592aece` prints.

title: usage() help string omits the new fold-check verb
evidence:
harness/main.odin:275: "fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]")"
harness/main.odin:142: "if verb == "fold-check" {"
detail: The new fold-check verb is wired in main.odin but absent from the usage() string, so a usage error (wrong arg count) prints help that never teaches the verb's syntax.
recommended_fix: Append `| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` to the usage() string in harness/main.odin.

title: campus-half floor hardcodes literal 10 instead of deriving from catalog
evidence:
core/demand_test.odin:647: "EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW"
core/demand_test.odin:754: "testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,"
detail: The campus-half floor uses a literal `10` (campus volume 1 x surge multiplier 10) while EXPECTED derives from the catalog. A surge-multiplier or campus-volume re-tune would silently drift this pin out of sync with MIN_LAND.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor from the catalog (campus entry volume x surge.multiplier x WINDOW x 95/100) instead of the literal 10.
